transcript.prompt: Draw 1 of 60: a red ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
I'll need to decide strategically about when to keep a ball. Since there are 8 colors total and 60 draws, colors are likely distributed unevenly. Keeping a ball costs 24 points, so I need to keep a color that will appear at least 25 times to break even, or ideally much more.

Right now, I have no information about frequency. It's generally better to wait and gather information before committing my one keep to a color, since once I pass on a color, I can never get it back.

DECISION: PASS
